title: Word Extraction, Sentence Parsing & Longest Word Test Paper (ICSE Class X)
prerequisites: ICSE Class X String handling methods, Scanner input, conditional branching, and loops
instructions: All questions are compulsory as per ICSE examination standards.
Write complete Java code for Section B problems including Variable Description Tables.
Pay strict attention to case sensitivity, loop bounds, and array indexing.
Each question carries marks as indicated.

sections.description: Answer in one or two sentences or evaluate the code output.

questions.q: Why is a space character appended at the end of a sentence before executing a word extraction loop in ICSE programs?
questions.answer: A space delimiter triggers the word extraction logic (`if (ch == ' ')`). Because the last word of a sentence is typically followed by a punctuation mark or nothing, appending a space ensures the final word is also extracted and processed.
questions.hint: Without it, the loop terminates without processing the last accumulated word.

questions.answer:
Output: `4 : 9`
Explanation: First space is at index 4 (after "BLUE"), and the last space is at index 9 (after "IS").
questions.hint: indexOf searches from front; lastIndexOf searches from end.

questions.q: What is returned by `"PRACTICE MAKES PERFECT".substring(9, 14)`?
questions.answer:
Output: `"MAKES"`
Explanation: Substring starts at index 9 ('M') and extends up to index 14 (' '), excluding index 14.
questions.hint: The second parameter is the exclusive upper bound.

questions.q: What bug occurs if an extraction loop does `word = word + ch` without resetting `word = ""` after space?
questions.answer: Subsequent words concatenate onto earlier words, producing a snowball accumulation instead of separate individual words.
questions.hint: Accumulators must be reset after each delimiter.

questions.q: Write a statement to remove leading and trailing spaces from an entered sentence 'str'.
questions.hint: Use the trim() method from java.lang.String.

sections.description: Write complete Java programs with class declaration, main method, and Variable Description Table.

questions.q: Write a program to accept a sentence terminated by '.' or '?'. Extract each word, determine the longest word and display it along with its character count. Include a Variable Description Table.
questions.hint: Accumulate chars into word until space, then compare word.length() with longestWord.length().

questions.q: Write a program to accept a sentence. Display only those words that begin with a vowel.
questions.hint: Check if vowels.indexOf(word.charAt(0)) != -1 after extracting each word.
